claim: Design readiness and existing-code characterization only; no conversion or observational validation
policy_origin: Project design decisions informed by cited primary references and Mission 35 limitations
tolerance_status: Must be frozen in a later independent conversion-evidence protocol before residual measurement

future_scenarios.input_class: Missing scale or reference position
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Keep legacy arithmetic labelled; reject strict prediction and observing export

future_scenarios.input_class: Complete BJD TDB epoch with TDB period
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Allow source-coordinate arithmetic; require validated arrival resolver for observing use

future_scenarios.input_class: BJD with no scale or offset date with no zero point
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Reject strict interpretation; do not infer from magnitude or label

future_scenarios.input_class: HJD with a stated scale
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Retain source metadata; strict prediction/resolution unsupported in initial implementation

future_scenarios.input_class: UTC observing query against BJD ephemeris
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Do not compare raw numbers; coordinate-aware candidate selection then arrival-midpoint filtering

future_scenarios.input_class: Both correction signs, sites, seasons and sky directions
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Later converter must match independent pinned references within a predeclared bound

future_scenarios.input_class: Missing site, target, required motion evidence, data coverage or failed solver
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Structured unresolved result; no UTC export or visibility

future_scenarios.input_class: Already-corrected event or midpoint-only correction copied to contacts
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Reject double correction; resolve endpoints individually or demonstrate a frozen error bound

future_scenarios.input_class: Closed exact point interval and exact dyadic endpoints
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Exact same-coordinate midpoint inclusion; no duplicate cycles

future_scenarios.input_class: Whole selected UTC dates
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Half-open range ending at next midnight; exclude next day, preserve source request policy

future_scenarios.input_class: Non-dyadic or sub-ULP boundary within numerical error
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Explicit boundary_indeterminate with candidates/reasons; excluded from eligible pass denominator

future_scenarios.input_class: Both uncertainty inputs absent
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Unknown total; never zero or maximum timing score

future_scenarios.input_class: Both uncertainties and covariance explicitly zero with recorded source or assumption
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Known zero model value distinguishable from missing; no perfect-knowledge claim

future_scenarios.input_class: Known epoch sigma and missing period sigma at cycle zero
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Known epoch sigma; zero-coefficient missing terms do not contaminate the result

future_scenarios.input_class: Missing contributing uncertainty at a nonzero cycle
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Unknown total; retain known components separately

future_scenarios.input_class: Nonzero cycle with missing covariance
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Unknown unless explicit zero-covariance assumption is recorded

future_scenarios.input_class: Known covariance with positive and negative cycles
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Independent analytic variance includes signed 2*n*covariance term

future_scenarios.input_class: Nonfinite, negative marginal variance or non-PSD covariance
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Reject; no silent repair or clamping

future_scenarios.input_class: Asymmetric errors, limits, unknown confidence meaning or unrelated fit parameters
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Preserve semantics and references; unsupported for symmetric joint propagation

future_scenarios.input_class: Unknown total with requested nonzero sigma padding or timing ranking
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Reject strict padded/ranked schedule; optional nominal preview remains unquantified

future_scenarios.input_class: Coordinate duration versus observer SI baseline across leap second
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Resolve declared contact basis then apply SI margins on continuous time scale

future_scenarios.input_class: Leap-second instant in datetime/calendar format that cannot encode it
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Explicit export error; do not shift the event

future_scenarios.input_class: Legacy schema-v1 schedule with UTC labels but no source metadata
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Keep legacy identity; no automatic strict promotion; require metadata and recomputation

future_scenarios.input_class: Metadata and unknown uncertainty through JSON/CSV/UI/export paths
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Round-trip source and conversion identity; null plus reason; gate every direct strict consumer

future_scenarios.input_class: Ephemeris outside declared fit validity or validity unknown
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Retain explicit model-validity status; no observed-accuracy claim from small propagated sigma

future_scenarios.input_class: Wrong correction sign, scale-only conversion, omitted site or unknown-to-zero mutation
future_scenarios.required_outcome: Future validation must detect each injected fault, not just round-trip consistency
